# Test fixtures

`rekordbox_demo_tracks/` is a real rekordbox USB export (database, ANLZ files and player
settings, no audio) from rekordcrate's test data, `data/complete_export/demo_tracks` at
https://github.com/Holzhaus/rekordcrate commit 68cd702e9c78bde4b9eab477e0a7547a0cb69768. It is under the
Mozilla Public License 2.0, like rekordcrate (https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/MPL/2.0/).
Used to check that Pocket Prep never changes a library it didn't write.
